resources.string: Controls how long the app searches before choosing a server. Turbo is enough for most networks.
Uses the first responding server. Choose it when you need to get online quickly.
Finds several working servers and keeps the fastest. Recommended.
Uses only servers proven to carry a tunnel, not guessed neighbours. With MASQUE-in-MASQUE or WARP×2, it keeps the two hops in separate ranges, which can change your exit address.
Accepts only a server that carries a real request end to end. For filtered networks where the tunnel connects but pages do not load.
